metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Aliou Barry

plugins.name: feature-status-tracker
plugins.description: Turns a Markdown feature table — or a raw feature list — into an autonomous dev pipeline: clarify each feature, then develop one branch + one PR per feature until the table is done. Works in English or French.

plugins.name: demo-video-generator
plugins.description: Generates a professional demo video (.mp4) of your SaaS app from a user journey: Playwright captures your screens, Remotion animates them (Ken Burns, highlights, text overlays) — Stripe/Linear product-tour style, no video editor needed.

plugins.name: spec-to-tests
plugins.description: Turns a list of features into a verified-red test harness: boundary contracts, table-driven tests, and a red check that proves each test fails for the right reason. Writes tests only — never production code.
